entries.title: Psalms 106:1
segments: Praise ye Jehovah. Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 106:2
segments: Who can utter the mighty acts of Jehovah, Or show forth all his praise?

entries.title: Psalms 106:3
segments: Blessed are they that keep justice, And he that doeth righteousness at all times.

entries.title: Psalms 106:4
segments: Remember me, O Jehovah, with the favor that thou bearest unto thy people; Oh visit me with thy salvation,

entries.title: Psalms 106:5
segments: That I may see the prosperity of thy chosen, That I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, That I may glory with thine inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 106:6
segments: We have sinned with our fathers, We have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

entries.title: Psalms 106:7
segments: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; They remembered not the multitude of thy lovingkindnesses, But were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

entries.title: Psalms 106:8
segments: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, That he might make his mighty power to be known.

entries.title: Psalms 106:9
segments: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up: So he led them through the depths, as through a  wilderness.

entries.title: Psalms 106:10
segments: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

entries.title: Psalms 106:11
segments: And the waters covered their adversaries; There was not one of them left.

entries.title: Psalms 106:12
segments: Then believed they his words; They sang his praise.

entries.title: Psalms 106:13
segments: They soon forgat his works; They waited not for his counsel,

entries.title: Psalms 106:14
segments: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tempted God in the desert.

entries.title: Psalms 106:15
segments: And he gave them their request, But sent leanness into their soul.

entries.title: Psalms 106:16
segments: They envied Moses also in the camp, [And] Aaron the  saint of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 106:17
segments: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And covered the company of Abiram.

entries.title: Psalms 106:18
segments: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 106:19
segments: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshipped a molten image.

entries.title: Psalms 106:20
segments: Thus they changed their glory For the likeness of an ox that eateth grass.

entries.title: Psalms 106:21
segments: They forgat God their Saviour, Who had done great things in Egypt,

entries.title: Psalms 106:22
segments: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, [And] terrible things by the Red Sea.

entries.title: Psalms 106:23
segments: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, Had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, To turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy [them].

entries.title: Psalms 106:24
segments: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, They believed not his word,

entries.title: Psalms 106:25
segments: But murmured in their tents, And hearkened not unto the voice of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 106:26
segments: Therefore he  sware unto them, That he would  overthrow them in the wilderness,

entries.title: Psalms 106:27
segments: And that he would overthrow their seed among the nations, And scatter them in the lands.

entries.title: Psalms 106:28
segments: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, And ate the sacrifices of the dead.

entries.title: Psalms 106:29
segments: Thus they provoked him to anger with their doings; And the plague brake in upon them.

entries.title: Psalms 106:30
segments: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment; And so the plague was stayed.

entries.title: Psalms 106:31
segments: And that was reckoned unto him for righteousness, Unto all generations for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 106:32
segments: They angered him also at the waters of  Meribah, So that it went ill with Moses for their sakes;

entries.title: Psalms 106:33
segments: Because they were rebellious against his spirit, And he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

entries.title: Psalms 106:34
segments: They did not destroy the peoples, As Jehovah commanded them,

entries.title: Psalms 106:35
segments: But mingled themselves with the nations, And learned their works,

entries.title: Psalms 106:36
segments: And served their idols, Which became a snare unto them.

entries.title: Psalms 106:37
segments: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,

entries.title: Psalms 106:38
segments: And shed innocent blood, Even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.

entries.title: Psalms 106:39
segments: Thus were they defiled with their works, And played the harlot in their doings.

entries.title: Psalms 106:40
segments: Therefore was the wrath of Jehovah kindled against his people, And he abhorred his inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 106:41
segments: And he gave them into the hand of the nations; And they that hated them ruled over them.

entries.title: Psalms 106:42
segments: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were brought into subjection under their hand.

entries.title: Psalms 106:43
segments: Many times did he deliver them; But they were rebellious in their counsel, And were brought low in their iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 106:44
segments: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, When he heard their cry:

entries.title: Psalms 106:45
segments: And he remembered for them his covenant, And repented according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

entries.title: Psalms 106:46
segments: He made them also to be pitied Of all those that carried them captive.

entries.title: Psalms 106:47
segments: Save us, O Jehovah our God, And gather us from among the nations, To give thanks unto thy holy name, And to triumph in thy praise.

entries.title: Psalms 106:48
segments: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting even to everlasting. And let all the people say, Amen.  Praise ye Jehovah.
